g.text: LKE Enterprise + Strimzi Kafka 4.3.1 (KRaft) with dedicated controller and broker pools
Linode dual-stack VPC · subnet 10.60.0.0/14 + IPv6 /52 · Cloud Firewall on all pools
KRaft controller pool · 3 x g6-standard-4 · TAINTED
Kafka broker pool · 4 x g6-dedicated-8 · TAINTED
Required pod anti-affinity on kubernetes.io/hostname places exactly one controller or broker per node (node affinity selects role=kafka-kraft / role=kafka-broker).
The VPC and subnet must be dual-stack (IPv4 + IPv6) to assign a custom VPC to an LKE Enterprise cluster. Controllers store the KRaft metadata log (20 Gi); brokers store topic data (100 Gi).
Pod requests are bounded by node allocatable, not the advertised size. The nodeport listener advertises the node internal address.
The Strimzi Metrics Reporter serves Kafka metrics on tcp-prometheus :9404.
